# `suspendFailToFailSync`

Suggests Effect.failSync/dieSync instead of Effect.suspend wrapping a single Effect.fail/die

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377163` |
| Language Service name | `suspendFailToFailSync` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/suspend-fail-to-fail-sync` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Data, Effect } from "effect"

class ValidationError extends Data.TaggedError("ValidationError")<{
  readonly input: string
}> {}

export const rejectInput = (input: string) => Effect.suspend(() => Effect.fail(new ValidationError({ input })))
/**
                                              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(suspend-fail-to-fail-sync): `Effect.failSync` builds this error lazily directly instead of wrapping `Effect.fail` in `Effect.suspend`.
*/
```

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/@effect/tsgo/schema.json",
  "compilerOptions": {

        "name": "@effect/language-service",
        "diagnosticSeverity": {
          "suspendFailToFailSync": "warning"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
